channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Wisconsin congressman injured slightly after lake emergency landing
item.description: The congressman thanked the pilot and first responders for their aid and expressed gratitude for sustaining only minor injuries.

item.title: Search ongoing for over 100 missing after Indonesian ship capsizes
item.description: Indonesian rescuers report about 130 passengers and crew missing after a ferry with more than 240 people overturned in bad weather in the Java Sea.

item.title: Elena Rybakina defeats defending champion Aryna Sabalenka to win first U.S. Open
item.description: Two-time defending champion Aryna Sabalenka lost to Elena Rybakina in three sets on Saturday.

item.title: Deputies respond to trespasser at Kamala Harris' Malibu home
item.description: A trespasser was reported at former Vice President Kamala Harris' home in Malibu, California.
